subject: Alzheimer's and ageing dismantle the brain's information topology
script: From Agewell Brief: Alzheimer's and ageing dismantle the brain's information topology. New mouse research shows that ageing and Alzheimer's pathology together dissolve the modular, synergistic architecture of hippocampal spatial coding—offering a biophysical map of cognitive decline. The hippocampus is the brain's cartographer. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
